verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer portal lists an official "CLI — Our Command Line Interface" alongside an API key and official wrappers, so a first-party command-line tool exists. The evidence never shows its syntax, a one-line conversion example, or use from scripts or CI. Missing for 10: documented one-line conversion command syntax, examples of non-interactive or CI usage (e.g. API key via environment variable), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the CLI works.
